name: Fire Isle
summary: 1–4 人在线或对战电脑的休闲六边形策略派对游戏，所有人同时放火争夺 Wisps。 Steam 开发者披露：部分 UI 美术与装饰物品最初以 Adobe Firefly 和 Claude 生成的图像与 3D 模型为基础，再由开发者在 Photoshop 等软件中修改；开发者称自 2026 年 3 月起与画师合作，逐步把 AI 生成美术全部替换为手绘美术。其他领域未被披露提及。

disclosureQuote: Some aspects of Fire Isle's UI art and cosmetics were initially created using Adobe Firefly and Claude generated images and 3D models as a base. I then personally edited all of this art in Photoshop and similar software to better match the game's art style. I have also been actively working with an amazing artist to gradually replace all of Fire Isle's AI-generated art with entirely hand-made art since March 2026.
disclosureQuoteNote: Steam 商店页 AI 生成内容披露栏原文（首句），2026-10-24 核查；可能随商店页更新。
